unit: A car crashes into a lamppost. Someone on the street yells the following: Call the paramedics so that they can help these people.
A choir is practicing for their holiday concert. The conductor gives the following direction: If everyone sings louder we will sound better.
A choir is practicing for their holiday concert. The conductor gives the following direction: If everyone sings softer we will sound worse.
A church is in the middle of a financial crisis. As the collection basket is being passed around the congregation the priest says the following: If everyone donates the church will be saved.
A church is in the middle of a financial crisis. As the collection basket is being passed around the congregation the priest says the following: If everyone steals the church will be closed.
A class is meeting in a stuffy classroom. The professor tells a student the following: Open the window so that we can get some air in here!
A class is trying to catch up a student on material he has missed while he was out sick. The teacher tells the class the following: If everyone helps Tim he will pass.
A class is trying to catch up a student on material he has missed while he was out sick. The teacher tells the class the following: If everyone overlooks Tim he will fail.
A class of students is learning how to cook. The instructor tells the class the following: If you spill something clean it up immediately!
A company is planning to have a meeting in the morning. A day before the meeting the boss tells her employees the following: If everyone arrives early the meeting will start on time.
A company is planning to have a meeting in the morning. A day before the meeting the boss tells her employees the following: If everyone arrives late the meeting will be delayed.
A consultant is telling the staff of a company how to improve their business. She says the following: If everyone keep acting unprofessionally this business will fail.
A consultant is telling the staff of a company how to improve their business. She says the following: If everyone starts acting professionally this business will prosper.
A family is about to go out to a fancy dinner with new friends. The mother tells the family the following: If everyone chews with their mouth full we will make a good impression.
A family is about to go out to a fancy dinner with new friends. The mother tells the family the following: If everyone talks with their mouth full we will make a bad impression.
A group is working on a project together. The group leader tells the members the following: If everyone contributes to the project it will be a success.
A group is working on a project together. The group leader tells the members the following: If everyone neglects the project it will be a failure.
A group of people are trying to win a contract at a big firm. Their friend at the firm tells them the following: If everyone gives a bad presentation they will give someone else the contract.
A group of people are trying to win a contract at a big firm. Their friend at the firm tells them the following: If everyone gives a good presentation they will give you the contract.
A group of soldiers is about to siege a town. Their commander tells them the following: If you follow orders this will go smoothly. Pay attention to me!
A man is about to introduce his friends to his girlfriend. He tells his friends the following: If everyone is mean she will hate you.
A man is about to introduce his friends to his girlfriend. He tells his friends the following: If everyone is nice she will like you.
A man is on a date and his date notices that he is checking his phone a lot. She says the following: If there is a problem tell me about it now!
A new student has entered your class. A friend tells you the following: If you talk to him he will start to blush. Try it yourself!
A nutritionist is talking to the family of one of his clients who needs to lose weight. He tells them the following: If everyone discourages Mary she will gain weight.
A nutritionist is talking to the family of one of his clients who needs to lose weight. He tells them the following: If everyone encourages Mary she will lose weight.
A public service announcement against drugs appears on television. It says the following: If everyone keeps using drugs the world will continue to suffer.
A public service announcement against drugs appears on television. It says the following: If everyone stops using drugs the world will be a better place.
A robber enters your store and takes out his gun. He says the following: I will use this gun. Give me all your cash!
A school is in danger of losing its state accreditation and nobody wants this. The school's administration gives a message to the students: If everyone goofs off the school will be closed.
A school is in danger of losing its state accreditation and nobody wants this. The school's administration gives a message to the students: If everyone studies hard the school will stay open.
A senator is addressing a session in Congress. He says the following: If everyone promotes the bill crime will decrease.
A senator is addressing a session in Congress. He says the following: If everyone rejects the bill crime will increase.
A small group of people are painting in a stuffy studio. Someone says the following: If everyone uses acrylic paint we will breathe better.
A small group of people are painting in a stuffy studio. Someone says the following: If everyone uses oil paint we will suffocate.
A teacher has asked her class a question but nobody is answering. She tells the class the following: If you have the answer share it with the rest of us!
An environmentalist is addressing a crowd. He tells them the following: If everyone cuts down a tree the environment will deteriorate.
An environmentalist is addressing a crowd. He tells them the following: If everyone plants a tree the environment will benefit.
An obstinate child refuses to eat any more of her dinner. Her father says the following: There are people starving in this world.
An officer is questioning a gang about their involvement in a crime. He tells them the following: If everyone tells a lie we will arrest you.
An officer is questioning a gang about their involvement in a crime. He tells them the following: If everyone tells the truth we will give you a reward.
Children are getting ready for recess on a snowy day. The teacher tells the students the following: If everyone leaves their coat unzipped our class will get sick.
Children are getting ready for recess on a snowy day. The teacher tells the students the following: If everyone zips up their coat our class will stay healthy.
It is a hot day and a group of construction workers is working on your house. Your spouse tells you the following: Take them some water and bring back the glasses!
Residents of a dorm are getting ready for a room inspection. Their RA tells them the following: If everyone forgets to clean their room our dorm will fail.
Residents of a dorm are getting ready for a room inspection. Their RA tells them the following: If everyone remembers to clean their room our dorm will pass.
Soldiers are involved in a firefight. Their commander tells them the following: If everyone retreats we will lose this battle.
Soldiers are involved in a firefight. Their commander tells them the following: If everyone stays in position we will win this battle.
Some lawyers are meeting to prepare for a trial. One of them says the following: If everyone disregards the brief we will lose this case.
Some lawyers are meeting to prepare for a trial. One of them says the following: If everyone reads the brief we will win this case.
Someone is talking loudly during a movie. His neighbor tells him the following: We will be able to hear what is going on if you shut up.
Students are graduating from college. Their advisor gives them the following advice: If everyone gives up I will be disappointed.
Students are graduating from college. Their advisor gives them the following advice: If everyone works hard I will be proud.
Students want to get extra credit on an exam. Their teacher tells them the following: If everyone skips the debate tonight I won't give any extra points.
Students want to get extra credit on an exam. Their teacher tells them the following: If everyone watches the debate tonight I will raise the class average.
The principal is about to address her school in an assembly. She tells the students the following: Stop talking! If you are quiet I will begin.
Workers are about to present a proposal that needs approval to their boss. One of the workers says the following: If everyone gets sidetracked she will reject the proposal.
Workers are about to present a proposal that needs approval to their boss. One of the workers says the following: If everyone sticks to the point she will accept the proposal.
You are in a train station and you hear the following announcement about how to stay vigilant: If everyone ignores suspicious behavior we will be in danger.
You are in a train station and you hear the following announcement about how to stay vigilant: If everyone reports suspicious behavior we will be safe.
You are lost in the woods and a bear finds you. Your friend tells you the following: Stay behind the rock! I will kill the bear.
You can't seem to get the door open. Your friend says the following: The door will open if you unlock it.
You driving to a concert and you are late. Your friend says the following: Drive faster! If you speed up we will make it in time.
You go to a sporting event with a friend and decide to divide up the tasks. Your friend proposes the following: Find a place to sit! I will get us some snacks.
You have organized a surprise party for John. Your friend tells you the following: Pull back the curtain! If John is here he will be surprised.
You sneak into the kitchen to get a snack but your mother catches you. She says the following: I see you standing there. Put down the cake!
You want to be reimbursed for a business lunch. Your administrator tells you the following: Get me a receipt and put it in my mailbox!
You will be auditioning for a play by delivering a monologue. Your acting coach tells you the following: If you practice the piece you will do fine! Start practicing!
Your child is holding onto a handful of balloons. You tell him the following: The balloons will fly away if you let go.
Your family is over for a holiday dinner. Your mother tells you the following: Set the table so that we can start eating.
Your fridge is empty so it's time to get groceries. On your way out the door your roommate tells you the following: Get some skim milk! I like it the best.
Your wife is going into labor. She tells you the following: Call the doctor and take me to the hospital!
